provenance.synthetic_entropy: Exactly 20 unique OS-CSPRNG entropy values; five each 12-word/no-pass, 12-word/pass, 24-word/no-pass, 24-word/pass. Frozen in random-inputs.json.
provenance.seed_derivation: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations, 64 bytes; NFKD(words) UTF-8 and salt UTF-8('mnemonic' + NFKD(passphrase)). Cross-checked bip_utils and explicitly normalized embit.
provenance.account_semantics: i is the application account index, NOT BIP44 account for EVM/BTC. All paths are explicit; no coin-class account defaults.
provenance.bitcoin: embit BIP32, checked against bip_utils; even-y lift_x of internal key; explicit tagged SHA256 TapTweak, Q=P+tG; 0x5120||x(Q); bech32m v1 mainnet bc1p.
provenance.btc_taproot_testnet: TEST ENCODING ONLY: tb1p is the exact same output key/script from m/86'/0'/0'/0/i, not a coin_type=1 derivation.

public_key_formats.bitcoin: 33-byte compressed SEC1 internal/untweaked key hex, including actual 02/03 parity
public_key_formats.solana: raw 32-byte Ed25519 hex, no bip_utils 00 prefix

provenance.unicode: Canonical English words only in entries. Unicode NFC/NFD/NFKD passphrase equivalence and genuinely different passphrases are checked separately in self-checks.json. No whitespace/case acceptance or product rejection policy is implied.
provenance.independence: No Avibe, avault, scure, noble, custody, runtime, or real wallet inputs/calls. Public reference artifacts and Python dependencies only.
